BP-FEED.independent_reading: BP500 PDF3 vertical precompaction pressure/distance; PDF4 adjustable auger/agitator and hopper level. No REV isolation/READY mechanism.

BP-BOUNDARY.independent_reading: Oil max300bar, literal1700kg/cm2, product dimensions and material-dependent throughput. No internal chamber/stroke/phase-time specification.

WE-USE.independent_reading: PDF7 printed6: wood/similar including paper/cardboard; 8–20% material-dependent; foreign bodies excluded in warranty. Not a REV moisture rule.

WE-START.independent_reading: PDF18 printed17: Hand start then Auto standby, level-triggered running and adjustable run-on. No qualified empty REV channel startup procedure established.

WE-HYD.independent_reading: PDF33 HS-4-01-006 Rev0: tong/press/fill cylinders, shared supply, valves and pressure switches. th200–th200S sheet; configuration compatibility not established.

WE-IO.independent_reading: PDF35/36 ES-4-01-073 Rev1 sheets2/3: S1/S2 press ends, S3/S4 fill ends, P1/P2 pressure, separate Y1–Y5 outputs including tong-open. Not PLC logic or validated REV feedback.

PR-FEED.independent_reading: PDF5 section2.2 and PDF30 section12.1.1: translating feed box; main pressing starts at completely shut end stroke. Distinct from retracting REV doser plus independent gate.

PR-HOLD.independent_reading: PDF5 section2.4: split sleeve/hydraulic tongs prevent material exiting during plunger return. Holding force, initial column and rectangular REV contact not specified.

PR-CYCLE.independent_reading: PDF30 section12.1.2–3: adjustable tongs oppose plunger; end switch reverses it; box/plunger return simultaneously, connected lever advances disk wheel feeding next portion. Not transferable overlap of independent REV drives.

PR-USE.independent_reading: PDF14 section9: sawdust8–14% plus other listed materials; metal inclusions prohibited due seizure. Not an exclusively wood-only manual and not permission for arbitrary REV mixture.

PR-SET.independent_reading: PDF33 section12.6: tong and pump gauges distinct, pressure-switch setting80 lacks unit, box opening depends on light/heavy material. No numerical setting adopted for REV.

AR-USE.independent_reading: PDF4–5 sections4.6–7: listed metal/plastic chips, sawdust, grinding swarf only; larger pieces/other materials excluded. Mixed-material machine not a certified REV process analogue.

AR-TOPO.independent_reading: PDF5–7: gather precompression, main retracted/partial/full positions, door open/closed and agitator linked to retract. Electrical cabinet disconnect door lock is not a separate press stop lock of REV.

AR-HOME.independent_reading: PDF8 and15: main/gather retracted plus press door closed for HOME; absence requires manual restoration. Not product-clear/receiver evidence or REV lock verification.

AR-CYCLE.independent_reading: PDF16–17: pressure vs partial-extend decides eject or gather again; pressure branch retract0.15s then open door and eject, then retract main/gather and close door. Timer is source-specific, not proof of unloaded REV.

AR-PAUSE.independent_reading: PDF8 neutral selector stops with oil to tank; PDF18 level-controlled stop/restart if equipped. Stopped motion is not zero electrical consumption.

AR-LENGTH.independent_reading: PDF19 section9.2.4/9.3.1: gather opening limit adjusts length; pressure adjusts density. Not a REV main/eject/return stroke prescription.
